title: Party Island last 5+ years
content: I am so excited to have found this sub. I have been going to what i call “Party Island” EVERY single night for at least the last 5 years. The map rarely changes. There is a Hawaiian like beach around the bend. Idk this is very interesting to see other people have similar locations and reoccurrence and whatnot. I have a hugeeeee golden mall & the bathrooms have a million toilets. Some stalls dont have doors, some have multiple toilets in the stalls. The liquor store is always in the same spot. There’s always love music & a festival like experience, why i call it party island. I do move apartments very often. Maybe once a month my dream self is in a new home with roommates or my partner. Just wanted to share lol
